title: Saved interfaces across accepted workflow revisions
summary: Focused supplemental installed proof: required binding mismatch is contained; complete authoring form stays disabled for explicit resource absence; common fallback visibly exposes current input without old run/review authority. Source restores through exact CAS; no execution or decision.

manualSteps.label: Prerequisite and contained saved view
manualSteps.instruction: Use the isolated fixture with the required output conditionally renamed from first_out to changed_out. Open its saved working-interface link for the current accepted digest with no run attached. Confirm the binding error and absence of a generated frame. The prior twelve-step report covers normal Workflows/file entry.

manualSteps.label: Complete authoring request
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface. Select the existing saved interface and its current saved revision. Set Interface title to Update evidence interface. Fill How should this interface help the user? with Update the required output binding to the current accepted workflow, keeping the shared Wright controls. Confirm Create interface and Update selected interface remain disabled with The qualified interface compiler is unavailable.

manualSteps.label: Visible fallback
manualSteps.instruction: Click Hide interface controls, then Use common working view. Confirm Brief (required) displays Synthetic review requirements and no old Approve action appears. Restore the isolated source through its exact conditional update; do not start or approve anything.
